# `company.shipment_return_revisions`

Append-only shipment return revisions: returned, then voided; the newest is current.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this revision. |
| `return_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with return_id + revision_number | — | shipment_returns.id | Shipment return this revision restates. |
| `revision_number` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with return_id + revision_number | — | — | One-based revision number; the newest is current and is the version. |
| `status` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | returned, or voided. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why this revision was written, as the caller gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this shipment return revision was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this shipment return revision. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this shipment return revision. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this shipment return revision. |
